name: Spool Peg
notes: Loom Keeper's loom phase (Jay OK'd the redesign, Nov 25): three glowing spools on pegs, called in around the room at half health. Passive: they never move or attack. While any is up the Loom Keeper stays on its loom and can't be hurt (lidWhileHelpers); breaking the last one makes it tumble down dizzy (dizzyAfterHelpers). Blender art (Nov 25): incoming-art/claude-guardians/spool-peg, Jay OK'd it Nov 25.
